description: This file defines the LogNode interface for a pluggable logging system in an Android application, allowing various logging targets and filtering.

classes.name: LogNode
classes.description: Interface for a logging system target that can output log data, possibly into a chain of log nodes for flexible logging.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Method to output a log message with specified priority, tag, message, and optional throwable. Implementations handle the actual logging.
